description: Implementation of system-agnostic parts of SystemInfo, including GPU vendor identification, driver version parsing, and system info printing.

classes.name: GPUDeviceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a GPU device.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Contains information about the system's GPUs and related properties.

methods.name: VendorName
methods.description: Returns the vendor name string based on vendor ID.

methods.name: hasNVIDIAGPU
methods.description: Checks if the system has an NVIDIA GPU.

methods.name: hasIntelGPU
methods.description: Checks if the system has an Intel GPU.

methods.name: hasAMDGPU
methods.description: Checks if the system has an AMD GPU.

methods.name: ParseAMDBrahmaDriverVersion
methods.description: Parses AMD Brahma driver version from content string.

methods.name: ParseAMDCatalystDriverVersion
methods.description: Parses AMD Catalyst driver version from content string.

methods.name: ParseMacMachineModel
methods.description: Parses Mac machine model information from identifier string.

methods.name: CMDeviceIDToDeviceAndVendorID
methods.description: Converts device ID string to vendor and device IDs.

methods.name: GetDualGPUInfo
methods.description: Determines active GPU and switchable GPU status.

methods.name: PrintSystemInfo
methods.description: Prints detailed system GPU information to stdout.
